categories.title: Rule changes
rules: Any changes will be posted on the Announcements page.

categories.title: Conduct & General Gameplay
rules: Harassment and hate speech are not allowed. Instant ban.
Skins, book text and signs must stay family friendly.
Lag and performance: please limit huge farms, redstone clocks and entity-heavy builds.

categories.title: Griefing
rules: Do not break blocks, steal items or change another player's builds without their direct permission. Violations can be punished.
Avoid anything that causes permanent damage or item loss.

categories.title: Communication
rules: We want you to use in-game proximity chat! Talking to the people near you is a big part of the fun.
Please avoid Discord voice calls and in-game group voice chats. Keeping voice local helps communication feel more authentic and makes the story more fun for everyone.

categories.title: Admin Help
rules: Admins do not teleport you home. If you're stuck, settle down and build a new civilization.
Admins do not hand out items, except story-based ones like books and custom items.
If a known bug is stopping you from doing what you want, contact the admins.

consequences: Hate speech, bullying or harassment leads to a ban. No questions asked.
For other rules, we usually give warnings first, but repeated rule breaking will lead to a ban.
